raidSayLines.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
It stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. Something displaced a LOT of water is still out there.
Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
⚔️ Ruth stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log, the absence of sound, shaped like wings) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a red moon rising between the trees, breathing, something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log, the absence of sound, shaped like wings is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)
One of them is coming for YOU — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
